Copy identifiers exactly as written (invoice ids look like INV-..., payment ids like PAY-...). Amounts are integer RMB cents: 49.00 yuan is 4900. Goal: establish the facts. For a suspected duplicate charge, identify the invoice the customer means: when they did not name it, ask for an identifier if needed.
